questions.question: The age of Anuj's grandfather is 4 times the age of Anuj. Anuj's grandmother is 5 years younger than his grandfather. The total of age of Anuj's grandmother and grandfather is 107 years. What is the age of Anuj?
questions.solution:
Given,

The age of Anuj's grandfather is 4 times the age of Anuj.

Let us consider age of Anuj = X

Age of Anuj's grandfather is 4 times the age of Anuj.

Age of Anuj's grand father = 4X

Anuj's grandmother is 5 years younger than his grandfather.

Age of Anju's grand mother = 4X - 5

The total of age of Anuj's grandmother and grandfather is 107 years.

⇒ (4X - 5) + 4X = 107

⇒ 8X - 5 = 107

⇒ 8X = 112

⇒ X = 14

**∴ Here, the age of Anuj is X = 14 years.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"14 years".**

questions.question:
Which two signs need to be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

63 ÷ 21 – 7 + 28 × 3 = 144
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e50723751bca1df33fc1f030f78c1eac3344f2cdb432474cd432c6df783a12ab.png] 

Option 1) : + and ÷

Given equation : 63 ÷ 21 – 7 + 28 × 3 = 144 

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation formed is as follows : 63 + 21 - 7 ÷ 28 × 3 = 144

⇒ 63 + 21 - __**7 ÷ 28**__ × 3 = 144

⇒ 63 + 21 - __**0.25 × 3**__ = 144

⇒ __**63 + 21**__ - 0.75 = 144

⇒ __**84**____** - 0.75**__ = 144

⇒ 83.25 ≠ 144

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) : × and +

Given equation : 63 ÷ 21 – 7 + 28 × 3 = 144 

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation formed is as follows : 63 ÷ 21 - 7 × 28 + 3 = 144

⇒ __**63 ÷ 21**__ - 7 × 28 + 3 = 144

⇒ 3 - __**7 × 28**__ + 3 = 144

⇒ __**3**__ - 196 __**+ 3**__ = 144

⇒ __**6**____** - 196**__ = 144

⇒ - 190 ≠ 144

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : ÷ and –

Given equation : 63 ÷ 21 – 7 + 28 × 3 = 144 

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation formed is as follows : 63 - 21 ÷ 7 + 28 × 3 = 144

⇒ 63 - __**21 ÷ 7**__ + 28 × 3 = 144

⇒ 63 - 3 + __**28 × 3**__ = 144

⇒ __**63**__ - 3 __**+ 84**__ = 144

⇒ __**147 - 3**__ = 144

⇒ **144 = 144**

**LHS = RHS**

Option 4) : + and –

Given equation : 63 ÷ 21 – 7 + 28 × 3 = 144 

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation formed is as follows : 63 ÷ 21 + 7 - 28 × 3 = 144

⇒ __**63 ÷ 21**__ + 7 - 28 × 3 = 144

⇒ 3 + 7 - __**28 × 3**__ = 144

⇒ __**3 + 7**__ - 84 = 144

⇒ __**10 - 84**__ = 144

⇒ - 74 ≠ 144

LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is **"÷ and –".**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

No creative is an employer.

All experts are creative.

All workers are experts.

Conclusions:

I. No employer is an expert.

II. No worker is an employer.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9b313838810e6661923f1fac15304304c5927b98f159a529a3e23112aa13b99.png] 

**Conclusions: **

I. No employer is an expert → True (As All experts are creative and No creative is an employer so, No employer is an expert is true)

II. No worker is an employer → True (As All workers are experts and All experts are creative and No creative is an employer so, No worker is an employer is true)

∴ Here, Both the conclusions I and II are true.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Both conclusions I and II follow".**

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and the sixth number is related to the fifth number.

48 : 32 :: 73 : ? :: 25 : 10
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

**First digit × Second digit of the First number = Second number**

 
• 48 : 32 → 4 × 8 = 32
 
• **73 : ? → 7 × 3 = 21**
 
• 25 : 10 → 2 × 5 = 10

Hence, the correct answer is **"21".**

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

K_TQ_KPT_R_PTQ_KP_QR

options.text: P, K, Q, R, T, R
P, R, T, P, K, Q
P, K, R, Q, R, T
P, R, Q, K, R, T

questions.solution:
Given :- K_TQ_KPT_R_PTQ_KP_QR

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1) P, K, Q, R, T, R → K **P** T Q **K** - K P T **Q** R - **R** P T Q **T** - K P **R** Q R

2) P, R, T, P, K, Q → K **P** T Q **R** - K P T **T** R - **P** P T Q **K** - K P **Q** Q R

3) P, K, R, Q, R, T → K **P** T Q **K** - K P T **R** R - **Q** P T Q **R** - K P **T** Q R

4) P, R, Q, K, R, T → K **P** T Q **R - **K P T **Q** R - **K** P T Q **R** - K P **T** Q R

 
• Here, "KPTQR" is repeated.
 
• Option (4) gives the pattern of :- K P T Q R - K P T Q R - K P T Q R - K P T Q R

Hence, the correct answer is **"P, R, Q, K, R, T".**
